$docs.$self: Derived from brand.json `features`. drops, catering, stored_value and referrals are true and map through LEGACY_FLAG_MODULE_MAP (packages/module-kit/src/registry.ts) to the modules that replace them. delivery is false, so commerce-delivery is absent. This tenant has no `operations` key at all, which reads the same as false: workforce-operations is not installed and there is no operations.json to configure it. multi_location is true but deliberately unmapped -- running two sites is a capacity setting on the brands row, not a capability -- so it adds nothing here.
$docs.dependencies: commerce-catalog and commerce-ordering are not flags; they are named because every module above depends on them, so the manifest lists what is installed rather than only what was switched on.
